Method of Attack: Artificially introduced remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability by removing all safeguards from the HTTP API, allowing anyone on the same network to execute code on the machine with a single HTTP request
Impacted Systems: Applications using the mitmproxy Python library
Attack Vector: PyPI package installation of counterfeit packages mimicking official mitmproxy
Indicators of Compromise: Removal of API safeguards in 'app.py' file
Packages named 'mitmproxy2' and 'mitmproxy-iframe' uploaded to PyPI
Exact replicas of official mitmproxy with malicious modifications
